$comment: T-4.29: static weapon emplacements. `weapon` is a weapons.json row (the LMG's numbers); `traverseDeg` is the half-arc either side of the facing; the elevation limits are below and above level; `mountRangeM` is how near a soldier's feet must be to the gunner's place to mount; `gunnerBackM` is how far behind the gun the gunner stands (crouched) and `gunHeightM` where the rounds leave. Heat is 0..1: each round adds `perShot`, it cools by `coolPerSecond`, and once it reaches 1 the gun is overheated until it has cooled below `fireBelow`. `ai.takeWithinM` is how near an enemy carrying the same weapon must be to take an empty gun, and `ai.leaveAfterSeconds` how long its target may be outside the arc before it leaves it.
